definition.en: The capability of a garment whose sleeve is a separate piece sewn into a closed armhole, its cap eased around the curve. It is the construction that gives a shoulder its shape and a garment its tailored line, and it is the one that asks most of the draft: the cap's length must match the armhole it goes into, with a stated amount of ease and no more.
definition.es: La capacidad de una prenda cuya manga es una pieza aparte cosida a una sisa cerrada, con la copa embebida alrededor de la curva. Es la construcción que da forma al hombro y línea de sastrería a la prenda, y la que más exige al trazo: el largo de la copa debe corresponder a la sisa en la que entra, con una cantidad declarada de embebido y ni una más.
definition.fr: La capacité d'un vêtement dont la manche est une pièce séparée cousue dans une emmanchure fermée, sa tête embue autour de la courbe. C'est la construction qui donne sa forme à l'épaule et sa ligne de tailleur au vêtement, et celle qui exige le plus du tracé : la longueur de la tête doit correspondre à l'emmanchure où elle entre, avec une quantité d'embu déclarée et pas davantage.
definition.pt: A capacidade de uma peça cuja manga é uma peça separada cosida a uma cava fechada, com a cabeça embebida à volta da curva. É a construção que dá forma ao ombro e linha de alfaiataria à peça, e a que mais exige do traçado: o comprimento da cabeça tem de corresponder à cava em que entra, com uma quantidade declarada de embebido e não mais.

aliases.name: set_in_sleeve
aliases.note: hyperobject.capabilities key; true on 2 cartridges as of 2026-09-02, and an interface id on many more — the flag is declared far less often than the construction is drafted.

constraints: Cap length equals armhole length plus the declared cap ease, measured off the drawn curves rather than computed from two formulas — the cartridges that solve the cap by bisection do so precisely because a formula-and-formula pair drifts apart at the extremes of the parameter range.
notes: Its alternatives are a family, not a fallback: raglan, cut-in-one, kimono and dropped-shoulder each solve the same join differently, and the catalog declares each of them under its own key.
